turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Singh from Nagpur?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is he. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Amit Sharma from the RBI regional monitoring cell. Sir, your bank account KYC has expired and we have received a request to freeze your funds.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Freeze? But I have not done anything wrong. Why is this happening?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is just a routine update, sir. However, if we do not fix this now, your balance of one lakh rupees will be locked and you cannot withdraw it.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh no, I need that money for my medicines. What should I do?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not worry. I can update it right now. Just give me your Aadhaar number and the 16 digit card number for verification.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am not sure if I should give this over the phone. Can I come to the branch?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, the branch will take days and your account will be blocked by evening. Just give me the details and I will send a confirmation OTP immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, let me find my glasses. One moment.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Please hurry, Mr. Singh. Once you give the card number, I will trigger the OTP and you must read it back to me to complete the KYC.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, I have it here. Do you really need the OTP too?
